title: 第二十一章 我可以入赘第二十二章 父母爱情
slug: 末世大佬穿星际四个竹马悔哭了
content_zh:
“上次……”贺兰逸喝了口酒，低声道：“就医院抽血那次，我就觉得她不对劲，她竟然打了我一巴掌。”
裴烬川眉头一跳，抬头看了他一眼。
贺兰逸摸了摸自己的脸，其实不怎么疼，但他就是很在意，那种感觉一直挥之不去。
魏谨言喉咙动了动，面无表情道：“她还看着我被赤璃打，她还说……”他顿了下，艰难开口，“我们不配跟叶峥比。”
话音刚落，裴烬川手里的酒杯就“咔嚓”一声，被捏碎了。
言煦之声音也开始发颤，“斩月……是不是真想跟我们划清界限了。”
没人说话，他们心里都明白，唐斩月不是“想”，她已经这么做了。
神经大条的贺兰逸最后反应过来，面色也白了，他神色茫然，“为什么？我们明明从小一起长大，还抵不过一个刚认识的叶峥？”
过了许久，言煦之起身道：“下周我爷爷寿宴，我会问清楚，斩月的不满，委屈，我都可以弥补。”
他绝不允许唐斩月就这么退出他的人生。
其余人没说话，但神色都坚定不少，大概也是同样的想法，唯有贺兰逸多想了一点：他们都去哄唐斩月了，那温晚意怎么办？
她们俩根本不可能和平共处，唐斩月那个性子……
贺兰逸啧了声，烦躁起身，“你们都回去找唐斩月吧，我自己陪着晚意就好。”
话音还没完全落下，人就已经离开了包间。
“这样也好。”言煦之叹气，“对不起斩月的是我们，跟晚意没关系，就让兰逸陪着她吧，免得她多想。”
裴烬川和魏谨言都没说话，显然是默认了。
另一边，接到通知的店长早已恭敬等在店门口，接到唐渊后，便大步将人引去楼上，口中还简单交代了下之前发生的事。
唐渊眼底透着凉薄，“叶季扬名下的产业好像没多少。”
店长眨眨眼，看向老板身后的特助先生。
庄怀利索地点开光脑，一边查一边给出具体信息，“两家做进出口贸易的公司，规模不算大，资源星三个，旅游星两个，其余的可以忽略不计。”

6。
店长掬了一把辛酸泪，她辛苦打拼买下的房产都不配上桌。
唐渊在出电梯的前一秒，淡声道：“他配不上这么多东西。”
庄怀立马点头，“好的，为叶季扬量身定制一份资产缩减计划，百分之七十怎么样？”
“不够。”
庄怀眼底闪过一丝同情，“那就定在百分之九十。”毕竟是叶家的人，也不好直接搞破产。
唐渊颔首，在包间前站定，按响了门铃。
店长默默后退两步，心中激动不已，奖金没跑了！！
没一会儿，门开了，苏苗惊讶，“唐总，您是来接唐小姐的吗？她才刚睡下不久。”
苏苗侧身让开，听到动静的叶峥已经立正站好，跟唐渊对视的瞬间就露出一抹礼貌的笑，“唐叔叔，晚上好。”
唐渊嗯了声，垂眸打量他。
客观来看，叶峥确实很优秀，无论是外貌，家庭还是事业，他的优秀都让同龄人望尘莫及。
如果叶峥喜欢的是别人家闺女，唐渊说不定还会羡慕人家能有一个这么出色的女婿，可偏偏叶峥看上了他家宝贝。
唐渊冷声道：“眼光不错。”其他的也就那样。
叶峥冷白的面色微微泛红，“谢谢叔叔。”
content_en:
"Last time..." He Lanyi took a sip of wine and whispered: "That time when the blood was drawn in the hospital, I felt something was wrong with her, and she actually slapped me."
Pei Jinchuan frowned and looked up at him.
He Lanyi touched his face. It actually didn't hurt much, but he just cared about it, and that feeling never went away.
Wei Jinyan's throat moved and he said expressionlessly: "She also watched me being beaten by Chi Li, and she also said..." He paused and spoke with difficulty, "We are not worthy of comparing with Ye Zheng."
As soon as he finished speaking, the wine glass in Pei Jinchuan's hand clicked and was crushed.
Yan Xu's voice also began to tremble, "Zhan Yue...does he really want to draw a clear line with us?"
No one said anything, they all knew in their hearts that Tang Zhanyue didn't just "think", she had already done it.
The very nervous He Lanyi finally reacted, his face turned pale, and he looked confused, "Why? We obviously grew up together, but we are still no match for Ye Zheng, who we just met?"
After a long time, Yan Xuzhi stood up and said, "I will ask clearly about my grandfather's birthday party next week. I can make up for Zhanyue's dissatisfaction and grievances."
He would never allow Tang Zhanyue to withdraw from his life like this.
The others did not speak, but their expressions were firm, and they probably had the same idea. Only He Lanyi thought a little more: They all went to coax Tang Zhanyue, what about Wen Wanyi?
It's impossible for the two of them to coexist peacefully, with Tang Zhanyue's temperament...
He Lanyi clicked his tongue and stood up irritably, "You all go back to find Tang Zhanyue. I'll just stay with Wanyi myself."
Before the words could even be finished, the person had already left the private room.
"That's fine." Yan Xuzhi sighed, "It's us who are sorry for Zhan Yue. It has nothing to do with Wanyi. Let Lan Yi accompany her so that she doesn't think too much."
Neither Pei Jinchuan nor Wei Jinyan said anything, obviously acquiescing.
On the other side, the store manager who received the notification was already waiting respectfully at the door of the store. After receiving Tang Yuan, he strode to lead him upstairs and briefly explained what happened before.
Tang Yuan's eyes were cold, "Ye Jiyang doesn't seem to have much property under his name."
The store manager blinked and looked at the special assistant behind the boss.
Zhuang Huaili quickly opened his mind and gave specific information while checking. "The two companies are engaged in import and export trade. They are not large in scale. They have three resource stars and two tourism stars. The rest can be ignored."
6.
The store manager cried bitter tears because the property she had worked so hard to buy was not worthy of being served on the table.
The second before Tang Yuan got out of the elevator, he said quietly: "He is not worthy of so many things."
Zhuang Huai nodded immediately, "Okay, let's tailor an asset reduction plan for Ye Jiyang, how about 70%?"
"Not enough."
A trace of sympathy flashed in Zhuang Huai's eyes, "Then let's set it at ninety percent." After all, he is a member of the Ye family, and it is not easy to go bankrupt directly.
Tang Yuan nodded, stood in front of the private room, and rang the doorbell.
The store manager silently took two steps back, feeling very excited that the bonus was gone! !
After a while, the door opened, and Su Miao was surprised, "Mr. Tang, are you here to pick up Miss Tang? She has just fallen asleep."
Su Miao stepped aside. Ye Zheng, who heard the movement, stood at attention. The moment he looked at Tang Yuan, he smiled politely and said, "Uncle Tang, good evening."
Tang Yuan hummed and lowered his eyes to look at him.
Objectively speaking, Ye Zheng is indeed outstanding. Whether it is appearance, family or career, his excellence is beyond the reach of his peers.
If Ye Zheng liked someone else's daughter, Tang Yuan might even envy him for having such an outstanding son-in-law, but it was Ye Zheng who fell in love with his treasure.
Tang Yuan said coldly: "Good taste." Others were just like that.
Ye Zheng's cold white face turned slightly red, "Thank you, uncle."
